limitations: Single full passing Responses pair; no stable whole-provider-suite speed guarantee.
Full CLI observations failed and cannot support an equally passing speed claim.
A 4.6-second AST identity check ran during the full CLI baseline; no build/lint/other benchmark ran concurrently.
RUSAGE_CHILDREN undercounts orphaned PTY grandchildren; CPU measurements must not establish waiting versus CPU attribution.
Integration experimental timing and identity entries are retained evidence, not the adopted patch. The fourth ABBA sample was not run after two candidate failures.
warmup_history: Provider dist/ was unchanged across baseline, trace and candidate; no build ran during or between those measured provider runs.
Integration baseline used the existing warm emitted build at node_modules/.cache/term2-integration-cli.
After adding the stateless CLI fixture helper, the exact native TypeScript incremental build was run outside timing before the candidate.
Every measured invocation retained its normal global setup, including a fresh disposable bytecode cache and --help priming.
All representative CLI runs used the same warm emitted build; only excluded test-source topology was swapped.
